verdict.rationale: SCIM directory sync is a fair axis for an auth product with enterprise SSO, but the evidence pack never mentions SCIM, directory sync of users or groups, or IdP-driven deprovisioning. The documented SAML 2.0 SSO is an adjacent sign-in capability and does not provide provisioning or deprovisioning.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can sync users and groups from customer directories via SCIM so deprovisioning in the IdP revokes app access
